headline: 5 PROJECTS. 261 HOMES.
caption:
Austin approved more than $21 million for five housing developments planned across the city.

Together, the projects call for 261 homes. Based on the City’s published unit mix, 248 would be income-restricted—including 54 homes reserved for households at or below 30% of Median Family Income. The remaining 13 homes, all at The Maven, would have no income restriction.

The five developments are:
• Rowen Vale — 64 homes near East Annie Street
• The Lenora — 39 homes on Menchaca Road
• The Maven — 83 homes near Highland Mall
• Jordan II — 66 homes on Philomena Street
• Austin Art Village — 9 homes on East 22nd Street

The Austin Housing Finance Corporation approved the five funding authorizations on October 22. Four projects previously secured federal Low-Income Housing Tax Credits; the city money is gap financing from 2022 housing bonds and HOME funds.

Important distinction: this is funding approval, not a claim that all 261 homes are already under construction.

Source: City of Austin Housing, October 22, 2026
